title: Sparkline
description: A chart the size of a word — trend without axes, made to sit inside a sentence or a stat.
usage: Next to a number that needs a direction: this week vs. the trend. It deliberately has no axes; if the reader needs values, give them the Line Chart.
a11y: Decorative by design — the number and delta beside it carry the meaning, and the figure label repeats the trend in words.
